ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure shows two triangles with their bases on the same horizontal line. The labeled base points appear in the order B, E, C, F from left to right. Triangle ABC is on the left with base BC, and triangle DEF is on the right with base EF. Reasoning: Since triangles ABC and DEF are congruent in the stated order, the corresponding vertices are A↔D, B↔E, and C↔F. Therefore side BC corresponds to side EF, so EF = BC = 8. Along the straight line, BF consists of BE plus EF, so BF = BE + EF. Given BF = 13, we have 13 = BE + 8, so BE = 5.
